data.summary: Overheat alarms include both real and false alarms; some machines show a 0.0 false-alarm share while temperature bands show false-alarm shares of 28.0, 23.9, and 25.0.

findings.claim: M-05 at F30 recorded 2 overheat incidents with a 0.0 false-alarm share, indicating at least some overheat alarms are real.
M-01 at B10 recorded 1 overheat incident with a 100.0 false-alarm share, showing that some alarms are false.
Outdoor temperature bands show false-alarm shares of 28.0 above 25 C, 23.9 for 15-25 C, and 25.0 below 15 C, so false alarms occur across all temperature ranges.

data.recommendation: Investigate machines with high false-alarm shares and calibrate overheat alarm thresholds before acting on every alarm.
